title: Print two words on separate lines and a quoted word. (Challenge 1)
description: Print two words on separate lines and a quoted word.
hints: Identify the main Python concept: comments & escape characters.
Write a small, direct solution and check indentation.
Compare each printed line with the expected output.
solution:
# Print a simple formatted message
print("Python\nLevel 1")
print("\"Codeora\"")
explanation: This exercise practices comments & escape characters. The solution uses the relevant Python feature and prints the required result.
commonMistakes: Forgetting correct indentation or punctuation.
Printing extra text that changes the expected output.
